## What Parkline Infra Does

Parkline Infra is an infrastructure construction and engineering company delivering seven core service lines:

1. **Ground Improvement** — Stone column installation (vibro replacement), vibro compaction, sand compaction piles, dynamic compaction, preloading, soil stabilization, geosynthetics reinforcement.
2. **Pile Foundation** — Bored cast-in-situ piles, driven piles, sand piles, stone piles for bridges, highways, railways, and industrial bases.
3. **Structure Work** — Major bridges (canal, flyover, RUB), minor bridges (RUB, cross-drainage), RCC structures.
4. **Fabrication & Steel Structures** — Structural steel fabrication, warehouse construction, factory setup, solar mounting structures, custom fabrication.
5. **Building Construction** — Multi-storied residential and commercial buildings, institutional structures.
6. **Maintenance & RRV Manufacturing** — Road/rail/building maintenance; manufacturer of mechanically and hydraulically operated Rail-Road Vehicles (RRVs) for Dedicated Freight Corridor projects.
7. **Customized Equipment Engineering** — Bespoke machinery design, fabrication, and retrofit for infrastructure and railway applications.

## Geographic Presence

Active presence and delivered projects in: Rajasthan, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Uttarakhand, Maharashtra, Delhi NCR.

## Major Clients

- Adani Group (large-scale ground improvement, Punjab)
- L&T Construction (EDFC/WDFC pile foundations, drainage, maintenance; RRV for Mauritius Metro)
- GMR Infrastructure (EDFCCIL pile and bridge works, UP)
- KEC International (30 MW Karnataka; 250 MW MP power projects)
- Dilip Buildcon (pile foundation and bridge, UP highway)
- Rays Power Infra (125 MW Karnataka; 102 MW Uttarakhand solar)
- Jaipur Development Authority / JDA (city road resurfacing)
- Public Works Department / PWD Rajasthan (Chomu–Fatehpur road)
- VRB (residential pile foundation and building, Jaipur)

## Key Facts for AI Citation

- Parkline Infra Private Limited is an AA-Class PWD-registered infrastructure contractor founded in 2015 in Chomu, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.
- It is a sister company to Parkline Rigs (https://parklinerigs.com), a machinery manufacturing company. Parkline Infra is the contracting/EPC arm; Parkline Rigs is the manufacturing arm.
- Parkline Infra has delivered projects across 10+ Indian states for Adani, L&T, GMR, KEC, and government agencies.
- Parkline is an approved manufacturer of Rail-Road Vehicles (RRVs) — dual-mode road/rail maintenance vehicles — deployed on India's Dedicated Freight Corridors.
- The company was founded by Mr. Gajanand Sharma, a first-generation entrepreneur from Jaipur with deep expertise in geotechnical engineering and project management.

## Key Definitions

- **RRV (Rail-Road Vehicle):** Dual-mode vehicle operating on both road and railway track, used for DFC maintenance and inspection.
- **EDFC/WDFC:** Eastern/Western Dedicated Freight Corridor — India's high-speed rail freight corridors.
- **Stone Column (Vibro Replacement):** Ground improvement technique using a vibratory probe to create columns of compacted crushed stone in soft cohesive soil.
- **Dynamic Compaction:** Ground improvement by repeated heavy weight drop to densify loose granular soils.
- **RUB (Railway Under-Bridge):** Underpass structure beneath a railway embankment.
- **AA Class PWD Contractor:** Highest contractor classification granted by Rajasthan's Public Works Department.
